context: Ryosuke and Tatsuya plan to spend new year together in the country.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: たつや、新年、皆で、過ごそう。
lines.en: Tatsuya — let's spend New Year's together, all of us.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Soft conviction—not asking permission, inviting inclusion. Slight pause before the offer, like he's been thinking about this. Voice steady and tender throughout.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. A quiet affirmation that comes from someone accustomed to deliberation. Low in register, grounded. Real pleasure underneath—understated but audible.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Hikari too—it'll be her first New Year.
lines.style: Voice softens on her name. Wonder and tenderness, like he's picturing it. Gentle anticipation—not rushing the moment, savoring the fact of it.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 家族、皆で、集まる、嬉しい。
lines.en: It makes me happy—having the whole family gathered under one roof.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Not performing emotion, just stating something that matters. Slow pace. The kind of contentment that doesn't need loudness, just sincerity.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 一緒の時間、大切に、しよう。
lines.style: Gentle but present. No rush—each word has weight. A quiet commitment, the kind that shows up in small attentions. Warm and steady throughout.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Simple, grounded statement. Not urgent—just a quiet fact. Warm undertone of welcome and belonging. Slight trailing-off, like the thought extends beyond the words.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: It's going to be a good start to the year.
lines.style: Soft warmth closing it all. Certainty without pushing—the confidence of someone who knows what matters. Slight breath on the last word, like settling into the feeling.
